paragraphs.source_en: “Darya Alexandrovna,” he said, now looking straight into Dolly’s kindly, troubled face, and feeling that his tongue was being loosened in spite of himself, “I would give a great deal for doubt to be still possible. I am in such doubt of everything that I even hate my son, and sometimes do not believe he is my son. I am very unhappy.”
